Subject: Budget range validation - monthly spend band & procurement thresholds

Hi Sophie — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and the pricing follow-ups we promised: 

Summary of expected usage (as discussed):
- Pilot (Q1): 10M - 15M tokens / month
- Post-pilot ramp (Q2+): 25M - 50M tokens / month

Procurement notes you shared:
- Procurement requires a standard SOW + PO for any multi-month commitment > $25k total spend.
- Anything above $100k needs legal review and can add ~3 weeks to timeline.

Unit economics we talked about:
- Target target unit price you asked about: $/1M tokens (we offered a starting benchmark for Gen models).
- I'll model out 3 scenarios (pilot, ramp, enterprise) with a couple of SKU options (standard verified open model vs quantized private variant).

Next steps (for alignment):
1) I'll send a concise pricing estimate that maps token bands to monthly spend and shows our recommended $/1M token tiers.
2) Please confirm your procurement thresholds (PO amount, need for SOW vs agreement) so we can make the estimate procurement-friendly.
3) If the numbers look reasonable, we can schedule a 30-min procurement sync with your team this week.

Attaching: redwood-pricing-estimate-novapay.xlsx (high level mapping).

Thanks —

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the follow-up and the workbook. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Volume check: the 25M-50M tokens / month is our internal upper bound if the pilot KPIs (latency, accuracy on our fraud models) look good. Pilot expected spend is likely ~10M tokens / month.

2) Procurement thresholds:
- Any vendor spend >= $10k / month needs a PO.
- Commitments that would create an annualized spend > $50k require procurement + legal review.
- For multi-region/data residency requirements we will need an addendum (likely later stage).

3) Unit price guidance:
We were hoping you could target ~ $150 / 1M tokens as a reference for initial modeling. If you can show savings at higher volumes (tiered pricing), that would help.

Happy to join a procurement sync — copying procurement to find a slot.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Head of Platform — NovaPay

Sophie — thanks for the clarity. Quick answers and an updated estimate inline.

Pricing model (3-tier example, hosted API, annual commit equivalent pricing shown as $/1M tokens):
- Pilot tier (10-15M/mo): $/1M = $220 -> $2,200 - $3,300 / month
- Ramp tier (25-40M/mo): $/1M = $170 -> $4,250 - $6,800 / month
- Enterprise tier (40-50M+/mo): $/1M = $140 -> $5,600 - $7,000 / month

Notes:
- We can show a promotional entry price at $150/1M for the first 3 months of the ramp if NovaPay commits to a 6-month pilot (helps reach your target while protecting economics).
- Dedicated reserved capacity or quantized private variants can push unit price down further (~$110-130/1M) but require a minimum committed spend and a procurement lead time for capacity reservation.

Procurement mapping (based on your thresholds):
- Anything >= $10k/mo: PO required — we can accept standard NovaPay PO.
- Annualized > $50k: we recommend a 6-12 month SOW with basic legal T&Cs; we can pre-draft the SOW and provide the SLA appendix.

Attached updated workbook with the three-tier mapping and a one-page SOW checklist for procurement: novapay-pricing-estimate-v2.xlsx, novapay-procurement-requirements.pdf

Next steps:
1) Sophie/procurement — confirm whether you want us to send a 6-month pilot SOW at the promotional $150/1M for months 2-4.
2) If yes, I'll get legal to spin the SOW and send to procurement for review.
3) We can run a 30-min procurement + engineering sync this week to align on PO flow and data residency notes.

If helpful I can also break down the per-1M token math (CPU/GPU costs, caching/batching assumptions) in a short appendix.

Thanks —
Dylan
